source.description: Technic mechanism: a central vertical stack of 24-tooth, crown and bevel gears with cams, driven by a long horizontal bottom axle, topped by a four-link lifting arm and flanked by two vertical black output shafts

nodes.description: Two long vertical output shafts of joined black axles with grey angle connectors at their bases, rising from the central mechanism
Long horizontal bottom drive axle with flanged bushes, support beams, axle joiners and angle connectors
Central vertical gear stack of 24-tooth gears, crown and bevel gears, cams and liftarm links transmitting drive up through the mechanism
Technic Cam with Narrow Slit and Recessed Axlehole
Technic Cam with Narrow Slit and Recessed Axlehole
Technic Beam  4 x  0.5 Liftarm with Boss
Technic Beam  4 x  0.5 Liftarm with Boss
Technic Cross Block 2 x 2 Split (Axle/Twin Pin)
Four-link lifting arm on top: paired black and grey liftarms joined by cross blocks and long axles
Technic Axle and Pin Connector Hub with 2 Axles at 90 Degrees
Technic Axle and Pin Connector Hub with 2 Axles at 90 Degrees

placements.policy: Nearest orthogonal analysis frame within rounding_limit; source translations and handedness preserved

gears.coverage: Candidates for coplanar external gears and reviewed finite perpendicular worm/spur pairs. b_per_a uses reported axes for parallel meshes only; worm ratios are magnitudes, direction requires review. Tooth phase, engagement, backlash, backdriving and collision untested. Unsupported gears are listed, not inferred.

opposed_gears.conclusion: Approximately coaxial, axially separated side gears; not a parallel external gear pair.
